immutable.authorityReferences: namespace-bound SHA-256 digests; raw references are not stored beside ciphertext
immutable.payload: AES-256-GCM through Phase 1 with namespace/store/record/schema AAD
immutable.envelopeHash: deterministic canonical projection excluding randomized ciphertext
immutable.mutationPolicy: reject integrity or dependency-projection mismatch; corrections require a new command

semanticMetadata.aggregateId: non-PII stable aggregate reference, namespace-bound and included in envelopeHash
semanticMetadata.dependencyIds: exact sorted dependency set included in dependencyProjectionHash and envelopeHash
semanticMetadata.use: command-type and aggregate matching without decrypting arbitrary cross-scope payloads
